sn9.3:1.1: On one occasion the Venerable Kassapagotta was dwelling among the Kosalans in a certain woodland thicket.
sn9.3:1.2: Now on that occasion,when he had gone for his day’s abiding, the Venerable Kassapagotta exhorted a certain hunter.
sn9.3:1.3: Then the devatā that inhabited that woodland thicket, having compassion for the Venerable Kassapagotta, desiring his good,desiring to stir up a sense of urgency in him, approached him and addressed him in verses:
sn9.3:2.1: A hunter, roaming in the rugged mountains
sn9.3:2.2: With little wisdom, devoid of sense.
sn9.3:2.3: Out of season.  Like this bhikkhu I exhort.
sn9.3:2.4: He strikes me as a dolt.
sn9.3:3.1: He listens but does not understand,
sn9.3:3.2: He looks but does not see;
sn9.3:3.3: Though the Dhamma is being spoken,
sn9.3:3.4: The fool does not grasp the meaning.
sn9.3:4.3: Still he would not see forms,
sn9.3:4.4: For he does not have eyes to see.
sn9.3:5.1: Then the Venerable Kassapagotta, stirred up by that devatā,acquired a sense of urgency
